title: Clean Vision
description: A partly, in-progress revamp of mc overlays, making all the annoying pumpkin overlays and the spyglass nonesense gone forever, also makes glass not ugly.
body: an in-progress pack that revamps all minecraft gui overlays and annoying block textures like glass being ugly and not connecting, we solve that! Annoying spyglass overlay and you can't see, we solve that! This pack solves everything wrong with minecraft!
